explication: OmniRoute is a unified AI gateway: clients send compatible requests to one endpoint, which routes them across provider connections and returns responses with fallback and streaming support. Its broader product includes model/provider discovery, compression, modality bridges, quota-aware scheduling, dashboard management, and CLI/MCP interfaces. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with source-index relationships and sampled calls; unsampled subsystems are represented at their existing directory paths, and uncertain wiring is left out.
